name: Minimum
description: Algebra Dash mod sequel - modern general optimization mod for Geometry Dash. Faster loading, reduced lagspikes, rendering improvements.

anti-aliasing.name: Anti-aliasing
anti-aliasing.description: Enables antialiasing to improve visual quality. Goes from Off (0) to MSAA x16 (4). Doesn't work on macOS. Requires restart.

fast-alt-tab.name: Fast Alt Tab
fast-alt-tab.description: Disables saving when minimizing the game for faster alt-tabbing.

force-rgba8888.name: Force RGBA8888
force-rgba8888.description: Makes the game always load textures as RGBA8888 instead of RGBA4444 to improve visual quality. Doesn't work on macOS. Requires texture reload.
